summary: Refresh (no thesis change, -7% on the tape): lorundrostat (aldosterone synthase inhibitor) for hypertension has a Dec 22, 2026 PDUFA (company release, Mar 9) backed by five pivotal trials; Mineralys held $646M cash (Mar 31) with funding into 2028, bought back the Tanabe royalty, and has defined launch territories. catalysts.name: Lorundrostat PDUFA — hypertension
catalysts.description: The NDA (add-on for uncontrolled/resistant hypertension) has a PDUFA target action date of Dec 22, 2026. Review is underway per the Nov 8 update, and a sales force is being built ahead of the date.

risks: Second to market behind AstraZeneca's baxdrostat, so approval is a re-rating event, not a monopoly.
Label risk (hyperkalemia monitoring) could cap the re-rate.
A CRL would mean ~-40–50% for a single-asset company.

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed funds 3.75–4.00% after the Sep 16 hike. CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~95% (Nov 17–18), with the remainder on 50bp. Waller has floated 50bp; Williams pushed back.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI ran hot (core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2%). Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Single-asset cardiorenal biotech moving to launch, funded into 2028. Rates matter through the biotech multiple only.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the Dec 22 PDUFA dominates; macro is WAIT (30/100) and the Dec 9 FOMC/Dec 10 CPI land two weeks before the decision.
